problem_text:
A logistics company is selecting cargo containers to load onto a cargo plane. Available containers are:
* Container 1: weight 1 ton, value 14 thousand dollars
* Container 2: weight 19 tons, value 10 thousand dollars
* Container 3: weight 4 tons, value 133 thousand dollars
* Container 4: weight 33 tons, value 179 thousand dollars
* Container 5: weight 24 tons, value 189 thousand dollars
* Container 6: weight 6 tons, value 273 thousand dollars
* Container 7: weight 50 tons, value 153 thousand dollars
* Container 8: weight 2 tons, value 79 thousand dollars
* Container 9: weight 4 tons, value 45 thousand dollars
* Container 10: weight 36 tons, value 180 thousand dollars
* Container 11: weight 5 tons, value 147 thousand dollars
* Container 12: weight 10 tons, value 186 thousand dollars
* Container 13: weight 41 tons, value 135 thousand dollars
* Container 14: weight 39 tons, value 13 thousand dollars
* Container 15: weight 28 tons, value 289 thousand dollars
* Container 16: weight 22 tons, value 229 thousand dollars
* Container 17: weight 48 tons, value 213 thousand dollars
* Container 18: weight 44 tons, value 206 thousand dollars
* Container 19: weight 30 tons, value 69 thousand dollars
* Container 20: weight 34 tons, value 12 thousand dollars
* Container 21: weight 29 tons, value 143 thousand dollars
* Container 22: weight 44 tons, value 68 thousand dollars
* Container 23: weight 23 tons, value 47 thousand dollars
* Container 24: weight 32 tons, value 181 thousand dollars
* Container 25: weight 34 tons, value 212 thousand dollars
* Container 26: weight 25 tons, value 61 thousand dollars
* Container 27: weight 35 tons, value 10 thousand dollars
* Container 28: weight 12 tons, value 220 thousand dollars
* Container 29: weight 42 tons, value 217 thousand dollars
* Container 30: weight 23 tons, value 27 thousand dollars
The aircraft has a maximum payload capacity of 545 tons. Select the combination of containers that maximizes total value without exceeding this weight limit. Each container must be either fully loaded or left behind.
